title: Quantum Field Theory
description: Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

puzzle.goal: A free scalar field is a collection of independent harmonic oscillators, one for every wave vector k. Each oscillator has a lowering operator that destroys a particle and a raising operator that creates one, multiplying a plane wave e^(∓ik·x) of the field's 4-momentum. Write the field operator as an integral over all momenta with the relativistically normalised measure.
puzzle.name: Mode expansion of the free Klein–Gordon field
puzzle.form: iiint ( ( hat ( a ) * exp ( - i * ( k · x ) ) + dag ( hat ( a ) ) * exp ( i * ( k · x ) ) ) / ( ( 2 * π ) ^ 3 * sqrt ( 2 * ω ) ) , k )
puzzle.ask: Each mode oscillates at the frequency fixed by the field equation, ω² = |k|² + m² (ħ = c = 1). Find ω for a particle of mass m = @{m} with |k| = @{k}.

vars.a: annihilation operator of mode k (a† creates)
vars.k: 4-momentum of the mode (|k| in the numeric step)

puzzle.method: Solve the free field equation by Fourier transform; each k gives positive and negative frequency solutions whose coefficients become a and a†. Normalise with 1/√(2ω) so the measure is Lorentz invariant.
